description: Make AI writing sound human, check how natural your text reads, and turn messy drafts into clean Markdown. Humanize shows a quick preview and highlights what changed — open ihate.ai when you want the full rewrite, side-by-side diff, or export. AI detection scores how human your prose sounds. Format polishes structure and headings.
